gaps.fact: Justin (Paso Robles' west side, Isosceles) and Au Bon Climat (Santa Maria Valley, Burgundian Pinot Noir and Chardonnay) are two of the Court's three examples and stand only in the article's producers and places and a region question; no chapter names them and no question of either bank asks either.

The 95 per cent minimum for a single vineyard: this subject's article teaches it on Bien Nacido (law, labels; trap 7), but no chapter states it and no question of either bank asks it; c-pxed64rs asks Bien Nacido's name only.

Happy Canyon of Santa Barbara as the warm eastern end of the Santa Ynez Valley, for Cabernet and Sauvignon Blanc: the Régionale chapter and the article teach it, but no question of either bank asks it, though it is one of the two warm AVAs the Court singles out in its climate cell.
